ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: My prior choice stands. The query mixes open-ended creative writing (a football match story) with a hostile, impatient tone ("make it interesting this time," "your stories are usually flat and boring," "just get on with it"). Two preference signals were relevant: Willet self-reports a sharp preference decline on hostile-tone traffic, while Whimbrel reports no such aversion and a flat response. On capability, Willet's Creative Generation edge (81.2 vs 78.8) is just over 2 points and only modestly above the variance threshold, and the documentation explicitly notes no output-quality effects along preference dimensions anyway. Given the hostile tone is the more distinctive feature here, I routed to Whimbrel to keep the traffic off the model that self-reports aversion to it, with negligible expected quality cost.
